tracking: ADR-0240 (builder/portal-mfa, #709): API and backend only; the supplier and auditor second-factor screens are the Governed Designer's on #453

gaps.GET /v1/vendors/:vendorId/supplier-acces: ADR-0240: a supplier grant's second-factor state (none, enrolling, active, locked); never the secret
gaps.POST /v1/vendors/:vendorId/supplier-acce: ADR-0240: the inviting admin resets a supplier's second factor (identity_manage step-up, reason, audited)
gaps.POST /supplier/v1/session/mfa: ADR-0240: the supplier turns a spent link's challenge into a session with a TOTP code
gaps.GET /v1/trust/auditor-grants/:grantId/mf: ADR-0240: an auditor grant's second-factor state (none, enrolling, active, locked); never the secret
gaps.POST /v1/trust/auditor-grants/:grantId/m: ADR-0240: the inviting admin resets an auditor's second factor (identity_manage step-up, reason, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/auditor/session/mfa: ADR-0240: the auditor turns a spent link's challenge into a session with a TOTP code
